title: Proper product composite and its two-counit transpose
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F_{p^a}}$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ for $m\geq1$. Use a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] with its specified canonical exchange and projection transformations [def-exchange-projection, def-sf-pf]. All schemes below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes and all morphisms are separated of finite type. Integral pullbacks and tensors are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite stages. Let $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$, $n\geq1$, and let $f,g$ be proper. For $f:X\to B$, $g:Y\to B$, put $T=X\times_BY$, with projections $p:T\to X$, $q:T\to Y$, and $t=fp=gq$. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ put $F=Rf_!K$, $G=Rg_!L$, $D=Lp^*K\otimes^L_\Lambda Lq^*L$. Define $\Psi_g(F,L)$ to be the composite $F\otimes^LG\xrightarrow{\sigma}G\otimes^LF\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{g,L,F}}Rg_!(L\otimes^LLg^*F)\xrightarrow{Rg_!\sigma}Rg_!(Lg^*F\otimes^LL)$, and define
$$\lambda_{f,g}(K,L)=\alpha_{g,q}\circ Rg_!\bigl(\operatorname{PF}_{q,Lp^*K,L}\circ(\operatorname{Ex}_{f,g}(K)\otimes1_L)\bigr)\circ\Psi_g(F,L):F\otimes^LG\longrightarrow Rt_!D,$$
where $\alpha_{g,q}:Rg_!Rq_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rt_!$ is the supplied composition comparison and $\operatorname{Ex}_{f,g}:Lg^*Rf_!\to Rq_!Lp^*$ is the canonical exchange. Identify all proper compact-support images with ordinary direct images by the canonical proper normalization. Under $Lq^*\dashv Rq_*$ the transpose of
$$Lg^*F\otimes^LL\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_{f,g}\otimes1}Rq_*Lp^*K\otimes^LL\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_q}Rq_*D$$
is $Lq^*Lg^*F\otimes^LLq^*L\cong Lp^*Lf^*F\otimes^LLq^*L\xrightarrow{Lp^*\varepsilon_f\otimes1}D$. Moreover the transpose of $\lambda_{f,g}$ under $Lt^*\dashv Rt_*$ is exactly
$$c_{f,g}:Lt^*(F\otimes^LG)\cong Lp^*Lf^*F\otimes^LLq^*Lg^*G\xrightarrow{Lp^*\varepsilon_f\otimes Lq^*\varepsilon_g}D,$$
where $\varepsilon_f:Lf^*Rf_*\to1$ and $\varepsilon_g:Lg^*Rg_*\to1$ are the ordinary counits. These equalities use the signed symmetric monoidal pullback comparisons and the adjunction-compatible composition comparisons.
